integrity: All proper simple games through four players are enumerated from minimal-winning antichains. Shapley–Shubik values are exact pivotal sums; nucleoli are supported by exact core or rational least-core certificates, and every game is canonicalized under player relabeling.
scientific_limitations: The classification is exact only for proper simple games through four players and compares weak player rankings rather than numerical distances. No larger-player count or asymptotic statement is claimed.
title: Sharp four-player ordinal divergence boundary for Shapley–Shubik and the nucleolus
